method: Use the existing stored potential unchanged under its original basename in a writable run copy; set the input atom label to Ni-imp so original constructors resolve Ni-imp_out.nml directly. Keep an immutable verified source copy outside the run directory. The candidate input must leave fresh_start false so reload is enabled. This avoids rewriting the serialized symbol, U/J, ql/pl, or any other potential fields.
compatibility_facts: symbolic_atom_mod selected_symbolic_atom_source checks <label>_out.nml first when reload is true and marks it as a restart.
symbolic_atom constructor passes the same label/database/reload to element and potential constructors.
element and potential constructors independently prefer <label>_out.nml and parse the existing namelists.
the endpoint has lmax=2 matching the proposal basis; build_from_file stores its arrays at the active lmax and zero U/J make hubbard_file_has_uj false.
fresh_start false is the default and load_symbolic_atoms_if_needed calls array_of_symbolic_atoms with reload=.not.fresh_start.
SCF save routines use the parsed element%symbol for output names; with unchanged Ni-imp symbol, output remains Ni-imp_*.
launch_precondition: Before future launch, audit exact run input/database resolution, ensure source copy hash and mutable working Ni-imp_out.nml hash both equal the accepted endpoint SHA before process start, and confirm startup reports Ni-imp_out.nml as loaded restart. No alias-file content edits are permitted.
